upgrade.path: Stock rc.5 CLI install of published v0.4.3, seed native owner chat, an unfinished intention and a project. Replace the plugin, open it through its fish and restart using the same profile and stateDir.
upgrade.observed: One installed card titled 精神, one dsh-jingshen preset. Native working directory, session IDs, permissions, history, intention and chat cursors survive.
upgrade.exactArchiveResults: See the release verification attachment for the distributed tarball and SHA-256.

visualInput.path: Linux Chromium, actual captured frames from test video and file-backed camera, local detection worker, explicit JPEG submission to image-capable model fixture.
visualInput.observed: 35 metadata frames, 37586-byte explicit image. Authorized playback advances the media clock and the fish watches while minimized. Minimizing releases camera, pause stops captures, closing page ends lease.

voice.browserPath: Stock rc.5 Web, phone entry from chat header, Chromium file-backed microphone, bundled Mandarin Zipformer ASR, real optional host-local PrimeTTS and Web Audio. Speech and button interruptions, mute and hangup.

distribution: Release verification attachment records final-archive install/upgrade and SHA-256 checks after packing. The final client adds one change relative to the recorded media run: it hides the floating launcher on the Plugins page so the card toggle remains reachable.
limits: Host autonomy and mediation cases use deterministic provider outputs. They test provenance, actual tool dispatch, native delivery, cancellation, revision and silence.
This release did not repeat the v0.4.3 authenticated production Breeze synthesis. Browser exercise used a file-backed microphone, not a physical handset.
Chromium responsive viewport only for mobile. Electron, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and long-term model learning were not evaluated.
Chromium extension toolbar authorization and real signed-in video sites need separate evidence.
